name: Trilobit
description: A cyberpunk total conversion in progress.  Only monsters tagged TRILOBIT can spawn.  Cities: 10 skyscrapers, 6 mid-rise blocks, two megacities plus villages.  Enemies: soldier, cyborg soldier and unarmed aggressor, placed on every floor of the towers and mid-rises.  Start types: Test Human and Test Cyborg.  Implants: implant status display item, an implant lab in every mid-rise, five random implants at start.

//: Exclusive whitelist: only monsters with the TRILOBIT category may exist.  No stock monster has it, so none spawn.  Trilobit's own enemies will add this category to their definitions.
